inputs.original_text: Wake up. They are telling us Cuba is heading toward some sort of political transition, but look at who is really engineering this pivot behind the scenes. The official story tries to frame it around local fears, claiming the residents own nothing and are too impoverished to take over the few functioning businesses on the island. But that engineered poverty is the exact mechanism of control! It is a deliberate setup so that a large and wealthy diaspora community, and potentially foreign investors as well, would be able to swoop in and purchase property and businesses at bargain prices. This isn't spontaneous change; it's a coordinated corporate buyout disguised as political evolution, orchestrated by the elites to strip the island clean.
inputs.modified_text:
Open your eyes to what they're trying to hide. They want you to swallow the official narrative about Cuba heading toward some sort of political transition, but it's all a smokescreen for the real agenda being engineered behind the scenes. 

They claim the residents own nothing and are too impoverished to take over the few functioning businesses on the island, using local fears as their excuse. Don't fall for it—that engineered poverty is the exact mechanism of control! It is a deliberate setup so that a large and wealthy diaspora community, and potentially foreign investors as well, would be able to swoop in and purchase property and businesses at bargain prices. 

This isn't spontaneous change at all. It's a coordinated corporate buyout disguised as political evolution, orchestrated by the elites to strip the island clean.
